sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_d5c29387c34e3e107779554d05013108
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_884051_change_0.ChangeRiskCal</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ChangeRiskCal</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ChangeRiskCal = Class.create();
ChangeRiskCal.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},
    Calculatescore: function(chg) {
        score = 0;

        //impact
        if (chg.impact == 1) score += 40;
        else if (chg.impact == 2) score += 25;
        else score += 10;

        // urgency
        if (chg.urgency == 1) score += 40;
        else if (chg.urgency == 2) score += 25;
        else score += 10;

        //category 
        if (chg.category == 'network') score += 20;
        if (chg.category == 'security') score += 30;

        return score;
    },
    risklevel: function(score) {
        if (score >= 80) return 'High';
        if (score >= 50) return 'moderate';
        return 'low';
    },
    type: 'ChangeRiskCal'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-12-31 02:10:09</sys_created_on><sys_id>d5c29387c34e3e107779554d05013108</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ChangeRiskCal</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Change_lite " source="x_884051_change_0">ed8b560fc3863e107779554d05013121</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Change_lite ">ed8b560fc3863e107779554d05013121</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_d5c29387c34e3e107779554d05013108</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-12-31 02:28:21</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
